name: Paseo RSF (formerly bistro)
notes: first-party client-rendered SPA (menu confirmed by grepping the built JS bundle, since curl of the rendered page returns an identical empty shell for every route); address/rebrand confirmed via site SEO meta (6024 Paseo Delicias, Rancho Santa Fe). Separate breakfast and dinner menus are both filed, section-prefixed Breakfast:/Dinner: since both contain a like-named "Sides" section with different items/prices. Excluded as adjuncts per playbook: six back-bar liquor-by-brand lists (Vodka, Gin, Rum, Whiskey & Bourbon, Scotch, Tequila & Mezcal) and the "Brunch Cocktails" section, which duplicated items/prices already captured under Breakfast: Beverages (Mimosa, Bellini, Bloody Mary, Bottomless Mimosa). One item, "Flat or Sparkling Water", was dropped: its raw price field is a two-tier string ("$6 / $10" for flat vs sparkling) with no single value to record without inventing one.

name: Brett's BBQ
notes: not_found: permanently closed. The Coast News (independent local journalism, not a directory) reported Aug 23 2018 that Brett's BBQ at 1505 Encinitas Blvd, Encinitas was closing for good on Sept 29 2018 after its lease was terminated, matching the batch address exactly. Yelp's own listing title now reads "BRETTS BBQ - CLOSED". No re-opening or successor at this address found.

name: Rosaria's Pizza
notes: not_found: two independent listings both tag this location closed - Yelp's own title reads "ROSARIA'S PIZZA - CLOSED" and TripAdvisor's page separately reads "Rosaria's Pizza - CLOSED", both for 6305 University Ave. No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub listing exists for this address at all, unlike a same-named sibling location at 3741 Mission Blvd (Mission Beach) which has an active DoorDash page and an Instagram confirming it is still open - meaning the chain overall is alive but this specific College/Rolando branch is not. MapQuest's listing still carries old present-tense marketing copy ("we continue to serve..."), but that page is boilerplate/unmaintained and contradicts the two independent closed tags plus the total absence of any ordering-platform presence at this address.
